about: Where each cost and tax component of a simulated trade must be verified, kept apart by who sets it. Document facts only: no rate, fee or tax value is recorded here. status: verified (document retrieved and its identity and effective date read), located (the document is identified but not retrieved), blocked (the publisher refused or did not answer this session), not-located (no primary document identified yet). Checked 2026-10-28.

components.applies_to: gains on sale of equity-oriented ETF units
components.document: Income-tax Act, 1961, sections 111A and 112A as amended by the Finance (No. 2) Act, 2024
components.notes: India Code and incometaxindia.gov.in answered HTTP 403; egazette.gov.in did not answer. Secondary sources report amendments effective for transfers from 2024-07-23; unverified. Whether a newer Income-tax Act applies to later years must also be checked at the primary source.

components.applies_to: purchase and sale of ETF units on an exchange
components.document: Finance (No. 2) Act, 2004, Chapter VII (Securities Transaction Tax), as amended
components.notes: Which rate applies to equity-oriented ETF units, and on which side of the trade, must be read from the Act as amended for each year in the window.

components.authority: Parliament of India / Government of India
components.document: Indian Stamp Act, 1899 as amended by the Finance Act, 2019, and the Indian Stamp (Collection of Stamp-Duty through Stock Exchanges, Clearing Corporations and Depositories) Rules, 2019
components.notes: The commencement date of the uniform stamp-duty regime must be taken from the gazette notification.

components.applies_to: how exchange and depository charges are passed to clients
components.authority: Securities and Exchange Board of India
components.document: SEBI/HO/MRD/TPD-1/P/CIR/2024/92, Charges levied by Market Infrastructure Institutions - True to Label, July 01, 2024
components.notes: Paragraph 7: effective from October 01, 2024. Sets the structure (uniform charges, the amount collected from clients equal to what the institution receives), not the charge values; values before and after that date come from the exchanges' own circulars.
